rules: For a logical single shot, explicitly say single continuous shot / no scene cuts.
For planned multi-shot, specify cuts with local timecodes.
On extension turns, local 0s means the beginning of the newly generated extension.
Do not replay earlier actions; continue from the exact end-state of the previous turn.
Describe audio changes or continuation explicitly.
Keep exact UI/labels out of seam-sensitive tail frames when possible; composite after the final temporal chain.
Use previous_interaction_id for model-generated multi-turn continuity when available.
